Click labels only need {action:6, x, y} display coords; the banked labels carry extra grid/sprite keys but the apply convention ignores them.
Direction mapping: ACTION1=up, ACTION2=down, ACTION3=left, ACTION4=right; every move is 2 pixels (sprites are 2x2 on a 2x-upscaled grid).

Row 63 is a tick counter that fills left-to-right on some actions (resets each level, 64 cap, jumped +7 once on a refused B-click); never hit the cap this session -- unknown if filling it fails the level; budget moves anyway.

B-button shelf shifts are REFUSED (no-op, counter penalty) if the standing piece would lose support; shifts are right-only with wraparound, so shelf gap-crossings are one-way -- crossing west requires the checker portal, not shelves.
The 2-button bar exchange is multi-stage and monotonic per stage: fully opening the top bar fully walls the bottom bar; plan bar usage order before clicking.
Blocked moves are true no-ops (NO CHANGE frames) but still consume env.step budget.
L5: clicking the 9-button while the west 9-block is your only planned descent route dissolves it (solidity transfers to the east 9-bridge); order matters.
